title: smtp/Cargo.toml license field missing AGPL-3.0 (links AGPL sieve crate)
description: smtp/Cargo.toml: license field does not declare AGPL-3.0 despite linking usenet-ipfs-sieve which wraps sieve-rs (AGPL-3.0-only). Operators distributing the smtp binary believe it is MIT. The AGPL copyleft obligation applies. Fix: set license = 'AGPL-3.0-only' in smtp/Cargo.toml. Document in README that usenet-ipfs-smtp is AGPL due to sieve dependency. CLAUDE.md already states this requirement — this is a gap between documentation and Cargo manifest.
